sentences.en: WOMAN: Hello, West Bay Hotel.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您好，西湾酒店。

sentences.en: Can I help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮您什么吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, good morning.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，早上好。

sentences.en: I'm ringing about your advertisement in the Evening Gazette.
sentences.zh: 我打电话是想咨询一下贵酒店刊登在《晚报》上的招聘广告。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Is that the one for temporary staff?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您指的是招聘临时员工的那则广告吗？

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: MAN: That's right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm afraid the person who's dealing with that isn't in today, but I can give you the main details if you like.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，负责此事的人员今天不在，但我可以向您提供主要信息，您看可以吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes please.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Could you tell me what kind of staff you are looking for?
sentences.zh: 请问你们目前在招聘哪类员工？

sentences.en: WOMAN: We're looking for waiters at the moment.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们目前在招聘服务员。

sentences.en: There was one post for a cook, a but that's already been taken.
sentences.zh: 之前还有一个厨师职位，但已经招满了。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: Erm, what are the hours of work?
sentences.zh: 呃，工作时间是怎么安排的？

sentences.en: WOMAN: There are two different shifts - there's a day shift from 7 to 7 2 and a late shift from 4 till 11.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 有两种不同的班次：白班是从早上7点到晚上7点20分，晚班是从下午4点到晚上11点。

sentences.en: MAN: And can people choose which one they want to do?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那员工可以自行选择上哪个班次吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Not normally, because everyone would choose the day shift I suppose.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 通常不行，因为我想大家都会选择白班。

sentences.en: You alternate from one week to another.
sentences.zh: 您需要每周轮换一次班次。

sentences.en: MAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm just writing all this down.
sentences.zh: 我正在把这些信息都记下来。

sentences.en: What about time off?
sentences.zh: 关于休假呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: You get one day off and I think you can negotiate which one you want, it's more or less up to you.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 每周有一天休息日，而且我认为您可以协商具体休哪一天，基本上由您自己决定。

sentences.en: But it has to be the same one every week.
sentences.zh: 但必须每周固定休同一天。

sentences.en: MAN: Do you know what the rates of pay are?
sentences.zh: MAN: 请问薪资标准是多少？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, I've got them here.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我这里正好有相关资料。

sentences.en: You get £5.50 an hour, and that includes a break.
sentences.zh: 时薪为5.5英镑，其中已包含休息时间。

sentences.en: MAN: Do I have to go home to eat or . . .
sentences.zh: MAN: 那我吃饭必须回家吗？……

sentences.en: WOMAN: You don't have to.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不必回家。

sentences.en: You can get a meal in the hotel if you want to, and there's no charge for it so you might as well.
sentences.zh: 如果您愿意，可以在酒店用餐，且完全免费，所以您大可直接在酒店就餐。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: Yes, so let's see.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我算一下。

sentences.en: I'd get er, two hundred and twenty one, no, two hundred and thirty one pounds a week?
sentences.zh: 那么我每周能拿到……221英镑？不，是231英镑？

sentences.en: WOMAN: You'd also get tips - our guests tend to be quite generous.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 此外，您还能获得小费——我们的客人通常都很慷慨。

sentences.en: MAN: Erm, is there a uniform?
sentences.zh: MAN: 呃，有没有统一的工作服？

sentences.en: What about clothes?
sentences.zh: 服装方面有什么要求吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, I forgot to mention that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我刚才忘了提这一点。

sentences.en: You need to wear a white shirt, just a plain one, and dark trousers.
sentences.zh: 您需穿着白色衬衫（款式普通即可）和深色长裤。

sentences.en: You know, not green or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 就是说，不能是绿色或其他类似颜色。

sentences.en: And we don't supply those.
sentences.zh: 不过这些服装需由您自行准备。

sentences.en: MAN: That's okay, I've got trousers, I'd just have to buy a couple of shirts.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没关系，我有长裤，只需要再买几件衬衫就行了。

sentences.en: What about anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的东西吗？

sentences.en: Do I need a waistcoat or anything?
sentences.zh: 我需要穿马甲之类的东西吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: You have to wear a jacket, but the hotel lends you that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 必须穿西装外套，但酒店会提供。

sentences.en: MAN: I see.
sentences.zh: MAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: Er, one last thing - I don't know what the starting date is.
sentences.zh: 呃，最后一件事——我不知道入职日期是哪天。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Just a minute, I think it's some time around the end of June.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 稍等一下，我想大概在六月底左右。

sentences.en: Yes, the 28th, in time for the summer.
sentences.zh: 对，是28号，正好赶在夏季开始之前。

sentences.en: MAN: That's great.
sentences.zh: MAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: I'm available from the 10th.
sentences.zh: 我从10号起就有空。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Test 47 7. 3408
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 测试47 7. 3408

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: Well, if you can call again you need to speak to the Service Manager.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果您再打电话来，需要找服务经理。

sentences.en: Her name's Jane Unin, that's UR W.A, and shell probabypasage.com arrange to meet you.
sentences.zh: 她叫简·尤宁（Jane Unin），拼写是U-R-W-A，她很可能会安排与您见面。

sentences.en: MAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And when's the best time to ring?
sentences.zh: 那什么时候打电话最合适呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Could you call tomorrow?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您明天能打来吗？

sentences.en: Um, she usually starts checking the rooms at midday, so before then if you can, so she'll have more time to chat.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她通常中午十二点开始检查房间，所以如果您能在那之前打来就更好了，这样她会有更多时间跟您交谈。

sentences.en: I'll just give you her number because she's got a direct line.
sentences.zh: 我这就把她的电话号码给您，因为她有直拨专线。

sentences.en: MAN: Thanks.
sentences.zh: MAN: 谢谢。

sentences.en: WOMAN: It's 832 double-0 9.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是832双零9。

sentences.en: MAN: 823 double-0 9?
sentences.zh: MAN: 823双零9？

sentences.en: WOMAN: 832.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 832。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Yes, I'll do that.
sentences.zh: 对，我会这么做的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And by the way, she will ask you for a reference, so you might like to be thinking about that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 顺便提一下，她会向您索要推荐人信息，所以您可能得提前考虑一下。

sentences.en: You know, just someone who knows you and can vouch for you.
sentences.zh: 就是说，找个了解您并能为您作证的人。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, no problem.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Well, thanks very much for your help.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的帮助。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不客气。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: MAN: Bye.
sentences.zh: MAN: 再见。
